- **is there a slot to increase the storage capacity from 256 to 512**
  
  Hey, In short, yes. It is possible, but since the system features one M.2 2242 PCIe® 4.0 x4 storage slot, you'd have to swap out the 256GB drive for the 512 to expand storage. Please feel free to reach out to us with any other questions!

- **Does this laptop have a warranty from the manufacturer besides the geek squad paid warranty? If it does how long is it warranted for and where can I find it?**
  
  Hey ObHad, yes, this IdeaPad Slim 3i ships with a 1-year manufacturer warranty. You can view the warranty information within the Lenovo Vantage app on the laptop under the Support tab, or via the Lenovo Support site after entering in the device's serial number. Please feel free to reach out to us with any other questions!
